task_definition.task_description: I need help checking for alternative electronics related to the Sony XM5 black headphones, then place a hold on 2 units for me. After that, see what coupons are available for my account, generate an invoice for the best recommendation and send it to user@example.com with Stripe payment, and then confirm the held order for those 2 units.

user_input.query: Hi, I need help with electronics. Please check for alternative electronics related to the Sony XM5 black headphones for product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, and place a hold on quantity 2 for me. My user_id is user_001. After that, please see what coupons are available on my account, then generate an invoice for the best recommendation and send it to user@example.com using payment_gateway stripe. Once that’s done, please confirm the held order for those 2 units.
